notes: 1) test_double_click_sends_once does not prove the busy/disabled guards: with all of them removed it still passes, because the message input is cleared on the first submit and the empty required field blocks the second. Real behavior is correct, but the test is weaker than it looks. 2) Markdown links from passages are rendered without rel and may be protocol-relative (//host) or relative; no script path, just off-site links. 3) A chat call whose search raises (500) has already stored the user message, so a retry stores it again (own test: 2 rows for one question). The 503 case is handled as required. 4) Server-side /chat on not_plant/invalid analyses returns 200 with the no-source note and stores the message; only the UI hides the chat. 5) Reports are stored and owner-checked on write but there is no page that lets the owner view them, so 'visible only to its owner' is only true trivially. 6) Vendored checksum not checked. 7) Running pytest from tmp-T7.2 needs a local pytest.ini, since the main pyproject pythonpath otherwise shadows the worktree src.
